title: MaxBLD report rendered tree (the node contract)
$comment: THE one home of the report node contract (Spec 126 11a.7 structured tree; 126:552 R-27 one home; Spec 135 FE-29). Every golden `rendered_tree` validates against it; src/tests/surfaces/report-honest.logic.test.ts reads it and holds no copy; the renderer (MF-14) throws on a tree that fails it and the validator (MF-15) runs the same file. `status` = the 11a.3 closed forms plus `none` (no reading on this node; FE-28; Spec 122 1.2 per-field idiom inherited by 126:295); `confidence` = the 11a.4 set plus `none`; `provenance` = the 11a.4 sources plus `none`. `none` on a reading node and the one-message-node rule of a lifecycle tree are enforced by the lock, not by this shape. Extended only by a dated note, a register row and a lock.
